description: The expand and collapse chevrons in the Sales By Representative table measure 22 by 22 pixels. At least 44 by 44 is asked for, which is the ordinary minimum for a finger.
env: Environment: QA branch sv8582 (https://sv8582.qa.shopview.com), build v3.5-7168d14. Signed in as an Admin, in a browser sized to a phone — 390 by 844 pixels with touch on.
steps: Open Reports, then Sales By Representative, in a window 390 by 844 pixels with touch enabled.
Measure the tappable size of the chevron at the left of a representative row.

For comparison, measure the three-dot download button and the Show Unassigned switch. The named test data: sales representatives ZZAUTOTEST RepA (one invoice, S-16244) and ZZAUTOTEST RepB (three invoices, S-16243, S-16242, S-16241), plus Parth Fadadu (one invoice, S-15826); customers Aaborough Works, Aacastle Services, Aachester Partners, Aacrest Works and Beman Systems; both locations, Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
current:
The chevrons measure 22 by 22 pixels. The three-dot download button is 44 by 44 and the Show Unassigned switch is 44 tall, so it is the chevrons specifically.

The chevrons do work on touch and by keyboard, so this is the size only. It is felt on every use: a small target in a dense table is easy to miss, and the next tap lands on the row instead.
expected: Each chevron offers a tappable area of at least 44 by 44 pixels, even if the arrow drawn inside it stays small.
source: All interactive controls in the dense table (chevrons, toggles, the ... button, the dialog's X) present a touch target of at least 44×44 px.
